questions.question: In 1957, Bubble Wrap was originally invented to be used as ______.
questions.explanation: Alfred Fielding and Marc Chavannes originally tried to create textured wallpaper by sealing together plastic shower curtains. Bubble Wrap later found success as protective packaging.

questions.question: A Roman curse tablet found in Gloucestershire asks the god Mercury to punish someone who stole the writer's ______.
questions.explanation: The tablet discovered at Uley appeals to Mercury for vengeance over stolen gloves. It survives in the British Museum's collection.

questions.question: In 1919, Boston suffered a deadly flood when a huge storage tank burst, releasing millions of gallons of ______.
questions.explanation: The Great Molasses Flood of 15 January 1919 killed 21 people and injured about 150. A large storage tank ruptured, sending molasses through Boston's North End.

questions.question: In 2011, Charlotte Lee held a Guinness World Record for collecting more than 5,600 different ______.
questions.explanation: Charlotte Lee held the record with 5,631 different rubber ducks on 10 April 2011, displayed in a dedicated room.

questions.question: The name Frisbee came from a company that originally sold ______.
questions.explanation: Students tossed empty tins from the Frisbie Pie Company. The flying-disc maker Wham-O later adopted the similar-sounding name Frisbee.

questions.question: In Strasbourg in 1518, dozens of people were caught up in a mysterious epidemic that made them ______.
questions.explanation: The dancing plague of 1518 saw people in Strasbourg dance apparently involuntarily for prolonged periods. Historians still debate its cause.

questions.question: A message in a bottle found on an Australian beach in 2018 was originally thrown into the sea in 1886 to help scientists study ______.
questions.explanation: The bottle came from the German barque Paula and formed part of a long-running experiment to understand ocean currents and find more efficient shipping routes.
